title: GPT-6 Astra in code review: Gains, privacy, and cost
summary: CodeRabbit evaluated the GPT-6 Astra model for code review tasks, analyzing its performance improvements, privacy implications, and cost efficiency compared to previous models. The article provides practical insights for development teams considering AI-powered code review solutions.
problem_solved: Evaluates whether GPT-6 Astra delivers sufficient performance gains and cost-effectiveness for automated code review while maintaining data privacy standards.
why_valuable: Provides real-world evaluation data to help development teams make informed decisions about adopting advanced AI models for code review workflows.
